description.narrative: The monitoring aims to assess the DIPD’s administrative and financial management capacity, set-up, systems and procedures vis-à-vis MFA requirements including the Development Engagement Document (DED) 2021-2025 and progress made towards following-up on the financial monitoring visit in 2022 and the 2023 Review. Likewise, the assignment will consider the completeness and conformity with MFA requirements of the information given by the DIPD based on the request of the MFA with regard to the cooperation with the Palestinian partner Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine. The assignment will provide an assessment and recommendations for DIPD as well as inform the continuous dialogue between DIPD and MFA.
